WITH grouped AS (
  SELECT 
    u.acctscope,
    COUNT(ram.riskandmarginpivot) as cnt
  FROM riskandmargin ram
  INNER JOIN orders o ON ram.ordervault = o.recordvault
  INNER JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
  GROUP BY u.acctscope
)
SELECT 
  acctscope AS scope,
  cnt AS count,
  cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS fraction,
  cnt * COUNT(*) OVER () * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS ratio
FROM grouped
